name: c-file-whitelist-indexer
description: Filter C/C++ definition results by a project source whitelist.

commands.title: C File Whitelist Indexer: Reload Whitelist

cFileWhitelistIndexer.enabled.description: Enable filtering for Go to Definition and Go to Implementation results.

cFileWhitelistIndexer.preferWhitelistedS.description: When both header and whitelisted source results exist, prefer the whitelisted source result.

cFileWhitelistIndexer.compileCommandsPat.description: Path to compile_commands.json. The file list will be used as the source whitelist.

cFileWhitelistIndexer.whitelistFile.description: Optional path to a JSON whitelist file. Supported shape: { "files": ["a.c"] }.

cFileWhitelistIndexer.allowHeaderResults.description: Keep header results even when source filtering is active.

cFileWhitelistIndexer.showStatusMessages.description: Show a message when the whitelist is reloaded or invalid.
